subject: Plus-alias stripped on vendor email prevents supplier portal invite
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex+billing@harbor-supplies.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Problem accepting supplier portal invite

Hi Connor,

We got an invite this morning to join your supplier portal (Coupa link). When I click Accept it immediately reloads and says "Account already exists" and drops me back to the login page. I don't have an existing account under alex@harbor-supplies.com, but we use a plus-address (alex+billing@harbor-supplies.com) for vendor billing.

Screenshot attached. Can you resend or advise a workaround? We need to get set up to receive POs this week.

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Finance Manager, Harbor Supplies
alex+billing@harbor-supplies.com
+1 415-555-0199

Attachment: screenshot-invite-error.png (PNG, 128KB)

From: connor_obrien@redwood.com <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex+billing@harbor-supplies.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Problem accepting supplier portal invite

Hi Alex — thanks for the screenshot, that helps.

Quick summary of what I see: our invite service is rejecting the plus-address variant because our identity normalization strips the "+..." suffix before it checks for an existing account, which incorrectly triggers the "already exists" path when a different canonical address (without the plus tag) is present.

Short-term options:
- If you can try accepting the invite from alex.turner@harbor-supplies.com (non-plus) we can send a new invite to that address and link it to your billing alias after provisioning.
- I can manually provision an account for your vendor record and send credentials / a one-time reset link — I will need the legal vendor name and the billing contact (you're listed as Finance Manager).

Ben, Marissa — looping you in for visibility. Ben, can we do a manual create and map alex+billing to the new account while we patch the normalization? If a temporary invite link (invite-link.txt) helps, please generate and attach.

Alex — apologies for the friction. I know timelines are tight; we should be able to get you set up today if you confirm the alternate email or give me permission to proceed with manual provisioning.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com
+1 650-555-0147

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Problem accepting supplier portal invite

On Sat, May 22, 2027 at 10:03 AM Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com> wrote:
> Ben, Marissa — looping you in for visibility. Ben, can we do a manual create and map alex+billing to the new account while we patch the normalization?

We can do a manual create. Quick technical notes: our identity normalizer currently canonicalizes emails by removing any plus-tag and lowercasing the local part (historical reason: older customer directories removed tags). That causes the invite-check to think alex+billing == alex, and because the check sees a conflicting legacy record (alex@harbor-supplies.com) it fails the flow.

Plan:
1) I will create the vendor profile in the portal under alex.turner@harbor-supplies.com and add alex+billing@harbor-supplies.com as an alternate contact on the profile.
2) Generate a one-time accept link and send to Alex (attached: invite-link.txt).
3) Create a short-lived feature branch that preserves plus-tags for vendor onboarding paths (target deploy next week).

Caveats: if the customer already has an enterprise record in Coupa with alex@harbor-supplies.com we must be careful not to produce duplicate supplier IDs. I'll coordinate with procurement ops if there's an existing supplier id.

Attaching the temporary link now. Marcus — please file a post-mortem and add a unit test for letterbox/local-part-preservation.

Attachment: invite-link.txt (contains one-time accept URL)

—Ben
Ben Carter
Platform Reliability, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
